note: Open-source mods that keep one branch per Minecraft version. For a jump A -> B, modaccel port compares each repo's A and B branches on GitHub (their authors' real port) and learns the line rewrites that touch what Minecraft changed (tools/VersionMap.java --learn). {v} is the Minecraft version. A repo without both branches is skipped. Adding a repo here widens every future port; nothing here is per-version.
